== Summary ==
Identified: [[Ivan Gribov]]. Named in the caption.

== Description ==

[[Ivan Gribov]]. At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (18 May)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 18 May 2003.

== Source and credit ==

Photographer: [[Nick Kolnik]] (bluethrawn). On 26 May 2003 he wrote that he had taken more pictures at "last week's TCC Sunday tournament" (this event) than on 25 May: [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=27254#27254 post 27254] in "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend" (topic 1291), 26 May 2003. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]. He announced these pictures in [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=26390#26390 post 26390] in "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend" (topic 1291), 19 May 2003. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive].

Published on the MNSWCCG "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG Road to States" page, Event Pictures, 05/18, link "Ivan Gribov": [http://states.mnswccg.com/road.html states.mnswccg.com/road.html]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040319014922/http://states.mnswccg.com/road.html Internet Archive]
